name: EPIC 247172620
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.6 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,097 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.09 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,737 K at its surface.
